dict.string: Demonstrate the Nearby Interaction third-party accessory API with a Bluetooth connected accessory
This app uses the Neraby Interactions feature to ranging with third third part UWB devices
This app uses the device camera to improve NI positioning, no image is taken or recorded.
This app uses bluetooth to connect to a FiRa device, to exchange parameters and start UWB ranging
Bluetooth is used to exchange Nearby Interaction configuration data with a connected accessory.
